entries.title: LFM 2.5 Embedding 350M disabled
entries.summary: Kilo's live model list no longer carries this embedding model (it lists liquid/lfm-3-1.7b and liquid/lfm-2.5-24b-a2b), and POST /embeddings on the Kilo gateway answers 404. Its only route was that one free hop, so every request failed with upstream_exhausted (#8180). Re-enable when a host lists it again.
